verdict.rationale: Framer supports a code-based workflow where developers add Code Components and Code Overrides (React HOCs) that map directly onto canvas elements, and Framer X's React foundation lets designers build widgets developers can hook into backend services (framer-docs-3, framer-docs-32, framer-comm-4). However, Framer's model is fundamentally 'publish the site itself' rather than exporting design-to-code artifacts for a separate production codebase, so there's no true design-to-shippable-code export pipeline like plugin ecosystems on other tools. Missing for 10: evidence of exporting/downloading production-ready code from designs for use outside Framer's own hosting, clear component-to-code sync tooling, and independent developer confirmation that shipped code from designs is usable in external codebases.
